column1: Notes: Column 1 is the original factor from AEM JF 2014 (paper-vintage data through 2017Q3 then current FRED appended). Column 2 uses revised FRED data for 1968-2017 then current FRED appended. Both columns are identical from 2016Q3 onward.

Construction: Lev = Assets/(Assets-Liabilities) for security brokers/dealers. Factor = rolling seasonally adjusted log change in leverage * 100. FRED series: BOGZ1FL664090005Q (assets) and BOGZ1FL664190005Q (liabilities). Extension from 2017Q4 uses March 2026 FRED vintage.
